title: parseSortParam is the single place legacy/UI sort aliases are resolved for dashboard search
answers: Where do I add a new legacy sort alias for dashboard search?
Where is the sort query param parsed in the dashboard search API?
Which file maps old sort names to index fields?
body: Alias resolution for the dashboard search 'sort' query param lives in parseSortParam in pkg/registry/apis/dashboard/search.go. It first consults uiSortAliases (a small local map, currently only name_sort -> resource.SEARCH_FIELD_TITLE) for names the Grafana UI itself used, then falls back to the shared searchsort.ParseSortName (pkg/services/search/sort) that already backs the older /api/search endpoint for suffix-style legacy names (viewed-recently-desc, alpha-asc, etc.). Add new UI-only aliases to uiSortAliases; add new legacy /api/search-style names to the shared sort package so both endpoints stay consistent.
says: Where do I add a new legacy sort option for dashboard search results
Dashboard search sort parameter doesn't recognize my custom sort name
How is the sort query parameter resolved when searching dashboards
Which file maps old sort names to actual sortable fields
Need to map a new UI sort alias for the dashboard search
search: The parseSortParam function in pkg/registry/apis/dashboard/search.go is the single place where dashboard search sort query parameters resolve their UI and legacy aliases. It consults the local uiSortAliases map first (currently only name_sort → resource.SEARCH_FIELD_TITLE) for UI-native names, then falls back to the shared searchsort.ParseSortName in pkg/services/search/sort for legacy /api/search-style names (viewed-recently-desc, alpha-asc). Add UI-only aliases to uiSortAliases and new legacy names to the shared sort package so both the unified dashboard search and older /api/search endpoints stay consistent. This guidance applies to the dashboard search HTTP handler.
